runner_rules.answer_submission: same-origin BFF to Django /api/v1; no full-page reload
runner_rules.pre_submit_answer_key_policy: correct answer and explanation must not be present in DOM or client state before the Stage21 answer response
runner_rules.feedback_policy: use icon plus text plus restrained color; color is never the only signal
runner_rules.render_policy: memoize stable runner leaves and avoid cross-page dashboard data in the runner
runner_rules.mixed_language_policy: locale layout owns UI direction; question and option content use explicit language direction or bdi auto direction

network_resilience.retry_rule: reuse the exact Idempotency-Key until the server accepts or rejects the same payload
network_resilience.conflict_rule: never silently replace a payload after an idempotency conflict

security_boundary.authorization: backend authoritative; UI visibility is not authorization

responsive_states.mobile: single-column runner, full-width options, sticky safe-area navigation
responsive_states.tablet: single-column bounded runner with expanded spacing
responsive_states.desktop: bounded reading measure; navigation remains close to the task

validation.valid_example: online answer submission returns post-answer feedback and removes any queued record
validation.invalid_example: response exposes correct_option_id in the pre-submit AttemptQuestion projection

risks.preventive: isolated runner tree, memoized leaf components and no dashboard fan-out
risks.detection: Stage24 browser performance budget and long-session E2E profile

risks.preventive: locale dir on document subtree plus bdi/explicit question direction
risks.detection: bilingual component tests and Stage24 visual regression

risks.preventive: IndexedDB pending record written before retry and stable idempotency key
runner-only shell, reduced motion and no non-task cards

stage23: admin import screen consumes preview/commit resources without bypassing server validation
stage24: cross-browser E2E, accessibility scan, visual regression, performance and consumer-contract tests
stage25: CSP, security headers, session/key lifecycle, privacy and abuse controls
stage26: single-origin reverse proxy, environment URLs, deployment monitoring and backups
stage27: UX and learning calibration from real runtime evidence

open_decisions.safe_current_boundary: accessible neutral design tokens; no invented brand assets
History, Profile and Settings routes render explicit unavailable states instead of fabricated data
